VOLIBEAR_MOD.title: Volibear · The Relentless Storm
VOLIBEAR_MOD.description: Volibear, the Thunder Demigod of the Freljord, descends upon the Spire! Features 89 custom cards, 2 signature relics, 6 Epoch story cards, and full dialogues with the Architect & Ancients. Master Engage, Domain, Lightning damage, and Beastify to shatter this stone prison! Supports English / 简体中文 / 繁體中文.
